'''Sessa''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]]. It was a chaotic inhospitable world. Sessa was a tiny planetoid with irregular [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] that tore the planet's surface to shreds. The proximity of the planet to its [[Koth'lar|sun]] caused searing temperatures.<ref name="SotEPG" />
